items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: That's where I joined my sister, Lizzie Miles, international Creole song boy. She's known all over the world. So as I said before, it was Cliff Jackson's band.

ctx.x: Came back to New Orleans. Where did you play then?

Well, after that I went to New York in 1926. You were in New York. I played around New Orleans, went to New York. That's where I joined my sister, Lizzie Miles, international Creole song boy. She's known all over the world. So as I said before, it was Cliff Jackson's band. We used to broadcast over at WMCA nightly. We had a swell flow show there. I worked there for quite a while. After that job closed, I got homesick for the old New Orleans. So I could come back and play some more good jazz. I was just blowing…
Well, did you ever play at any other time with your sister besides that New York engagement?
